name: Cure for Death
source:
The story follows a young man who leaves his hometown to chase his dream job at a prestigious publishing house. Low on funds, he moves into a suspiciously affordable house — and quickly finds out the real reason behind the bargain price.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3648540/]Steam[/url]]
